notes.title: World Oceans Day Charity Sale!
notes.notes:
Hello shell collectors!

We're so happy to announce that we are supporting WDC, (Whale and Dolphin Conservation) for World Oceans Day!

The WDC World Oceans Day Sale lasts for one week until the 15th June, (10am PDT 2023), and Seashell is 50% off, with 100% of our revenue going to this very good cause. We want humans for generations more to be able to enjoy our beautiful oceans, so we're returning all of the shells we find this week back to the sea.

A little bit about the charity:

[i]WDC, Whale and Dolphin conservation is the leading global charity dedicated to the protection and conservation of whales and dolphins.

Their expert-led teams in the UK, Europe, the Americas, and Australasia work across the whole spectrum of threats, from climate breakdown to accidental entanglements in fishing gear. They bring together, and work hand-in-hand with, businesses, philanthropists, scientists, NGOs, governments and grassroots communities to find solutions to the problems faced by whales and dolphins.[/i]

Take a look at all the other great games in the sale here too: https://bit.ly/OceansDaySteamSale23

We hope you have a lovely relaxing time with the sea, listening to the waves and finding out about neat shells.

Thanks for supporting the 🐳 & 🐬 of our amazing planet!

*100% of our net developer revenue from this sale will support WDC, Whale and Dolphin Conservation. Whale and Dolphin Conservation is a UK registered charity (no. 1014705)

notes.title: 50% off Sale!
notes.notes:
On the Northern hemisphere of Earth, it's a great time of year to find some lovely shells. Seashell is half price starting 8am PT / 4pm BST! If you're not able to get to a real life beach, [b]Seashell: The Video Game[/b] is a great replacement.

You can also buy Seashell on Nintendo Switch, Itch.io, the Google Play Store and the Apple App Store, and I've set up sales on all platforms until the 19th of June if you prefer playing it somewhere else.

Enjoy and take care, thank you so much for all your support.

notes.title: April Update
notes.notes:
Huge thanks to everyone who has tried our game so far, we're very happy to be at 10 reviews and they're all positive!

We added a couple of things after hearing your feedback.


[b]1. Extra hints to help you find the legendary shells, take a look in your journal![/b]

My brother in law (usually a very kind and quiet man) said he'd put a brick through our window if he couldn't find the last legendary shell. I can't imagine how crazy it must have made players who don't know or like us. 

Our programmer said before we released, "I think this last shell is too difficult and we should add more hints." I replied, "Nahhh it's fine, people love a challenge!" I was wrong and promise to listen to him in future.


[b]2. Additional UI feedback for combos![/b]

Another family story but, I am [b]SO[/b] pleased that I've finally made a game that my mum enjoys. She has over 80,000 points in Seashell and found everything excluding the Nautilus and Carrier, somehow, because she had no idea about the combo system. I made the glowing outlines of a full 4 shell combo thicker and added a little animation. Hopefully it's more obvious on tiny mobile phones.


[b]3. Fixed some gross colour banding on the dialog popups that nobody will notice but me. [/b]

If you have any requests for new features or find any bugs please let us know. Though bugs are also cool, this game is about finding molluscs.

Thanks again and enjoy! 
- Laura
